title: play rug
text: play rug. I purchased this for my 5 and 8 year old grandsons to use with their various cars, trucks, lincoln logs, army guys, etc... And they choose it often.  The back is rubberized. It is fairly thick - but too much so - it feels sturdy. The rug print is large - plenty of room for two to share space - eye balling it spread out it looks like about 2 1/2 to 3' wide and about 4' long. After a few uses, they noticed the print pattern repeats... so it's like its one print that has been doubled.  They talk about the buildings... they make up stories about the structures and even the streets and ponds... I'm sure they will get tired of it eventually... but I think I'll get the price of the rug out of it and then I'll share it with a local daycare or women's shelter.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
